cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Don’t Question the Premise
cards.instruction: Redirect every attempt to ask why the strange situation exists toward what must happen next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The ghost's waiting at our breakfast table. Do we have cereal? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why is it haunting our kitchen? We're already late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then give it the instant porridge. I'll find a bowl.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why would a dead person need feeding? I'm taking the car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll put it in a travel cup. You can drop it at the cemetery on your way.

mechanism: A manages ghost breakfast and changes speed and transport around B needs while redirecting every why question into another practical task.
confusable: Unlike explaining or defending the impossible premise, A uses the practical part of each B reply and ignores its causal question.
comparison: Ghost breakfast during departure differs from containing a leaking gallery seascape.
seedUse: D158-a lateness, instant porridge and car; S02-a adapts logistics to preserve B participation.
